answer: One concrete defense ties each agent to a stake bond that vests slowly, like a vine that must root across many epochs before it bears weight; cheap clones cannot fake that lived history. Peers attest to real work, and every attestation adds a thread to a public ledger, so forging thousands of identities would demand thousands of independent, costly stakes. Honest agents accrue a crystal-clear reputation trail, keeping sybils both unprofitable and plainly visible.
